notes.note: Reviewed EngineSignInPanel and its AgentConnectionView caller after the scoped-state repair in 67ea955ef93. The panel now remounts all ephemeral discovery, attempt, mutation, terminal and credential draft state for the tuple of API base, authority key and engine connection; absent authority unmounts it. Existing guide claims about per-engine sign-in methods, credential fields and scope permissions remain accurate, so no prose change is needed. Focused panel and owning view tests passed 57/57; removing the identity key caused three intended draft-isolation failures, and exact source restoration passed 10/10 panel tests. This is local UI evidence using fixture keys and transport, not real provider sign-in proof.
